description: A chunky cartoon fire engine. At the front a flat-fronted crew cab with a large two-pane windshield, one side window in the front door and two in the crew doors behind it, a red light bar with a white centre segment on the cab roof, a light grey slatted grille and two pale headlights on the front face, a light grey side mirror at each front corner and a full-width light grey front bumper. Behind the cab a long boxy equipment body with three large closed light grey locker doors along its flank, a long light silver-grey ladder lying flat on top of the body from front to back on short grey supports, and a small red lamp block on each top rear corner. A white horizontal stripe runs along the whole side of the cab and the body. A full-width light grey rear bumper. Six wheels (one front axle, two rear axles close together) with dark charcoal tyres and light grey hubs. Body bright fire-engine red, stripe white, ladder light silver-grey, windows pale blue-grey, bumpers, grille, lockers and hubs light grey, tyres dark charcoal.
proportions: at a width of 2.5 m (the cab and the body exactly the same width), the truck is 6.95 m long from the cab front to the body rear and 7.35 m from bumper to bumper (each bumper 0.2 m deep; the front bumper 2.70 m wide, 0.1 m proud per side, the rear bumper 2.6-2.7 m wide), and 2.95 m tall from the ground to the top of the ladder, with the body roof at 2.75 m and the cab roof at 2.6 m (length : width : height = 2.78 : 1 : 1.18); the ladder is 0.9 m wide, centred on the body, running from the body's front to 0.35 m short of its rear on 3 short supports per rail; the light bar is 1.9 m across and 0.3 m long with a 0.5 m white centre segment, 0.3 m behind the nose; the mirror heads at the front doors reach 1.45 m from the centre line; the wheels are 1.03 m in diameter; the front axle is 2.38 m ahead of the body's centre, the two rear axles 1.28 and 2.36 m behind it.
sides: the fire truck is symmetric left to right: the same windows, lockers, white stripe and side mirror on both flanks, the light bar and the ladder centred on the roof.

faces.front: The roof ladder is seen end-on: one thin light silver-grey strip on its two short supports above the cab roof, never its rungs; the light bar is one bar across the cab roof.
faces.rear: The roof ladder is seen end-on: one thin light silver-grey strip on its two short supports, never its rungs. Each rear wheel is a single tyre exactly as wide as a front tyre (no dual tyres), and the body is exactly as wide as the cab in the front view.
faces.top: The body and the cab are exactly the same width, 2.5 m, with no step between them (a thin cel band of the near-flank lockers may show, inside that width). The ladder is seen from above with its two rails and 11 to 12 rungs: 0.9 m wide, centred on the body, from the body's front edge to 0.35 m short of its rear edge, on 3 short supports per rail. The light bar lies across the cab roof, 1.9 m x 0.3 m with a 0.5 m white centre segment, 0.3 m behind the nose. The mirror heads are at the front doors, their outer edge 1.45 m from the centre line, on arms to the cab. Two small red lamp blocks (0.2 x 0.28 m) sit on the body's two top rear corners at its outer edges. The front bumper 2.70 m across and 0.2 m deep, the rear bumper 2.6-2.7 m across and 0.2 m deep. Windshield and side windows only as thin flat bands; no ground shadow.
